name: CLB Full-Stack Developer Resources
description: Valuable links for each of the projects we're on.

steps.name: GitHub
steps.objective: GitHub is owned by Microsoft and is tightly integrated into everything we do. While that is the case, GitHub doesn't have Single-Sign On with your BC Gov account. You'll need to create a GitHub account and ensure it has Multi-Factor Authentication turned on in order to join to requisite organizations to make contributions.

bookmarks.title: B.C. government DevHub | Application developer guide | Use Github In Bcgov | Bc Government Organizations In Github
bookmarks.description: The B.C. government DevHub is a place to access common technical documentation, community knowledge bases, code samples and APIs.
bookmarks.context: Create an account, get joined to the "BCGov" GitHub org.

bookmarks.title: bcgov
bookmarks.description: This is the home for code that is open. bcgov has 2435 repositories available. Follow their code on GitHub.
bookmarks.context: The primary BCGOV organization on GitHub. You need to be a member here if you want to make contributions to our open source projects that reside on OpenShift.

steps.name: LSApp
steps.objective: Learning Support Administration Application is the "middleware" of Corporate Learning. It contains the canonical list of corporate learning courses and a growing list of the associated metadata that supports delivery and maintenance of the catalogue. From partnership information to class sizes and enrolment info, LSApp has answers to many of your questions.

bookmarks.title: LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application)
bookmarks.description: LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application) acts as middleware between the many different learning systems that CLB deals with.
bookmarks.context: The application itself. You need an IDIR to request access.

bookmarks.title: GitHub Project · LSApp
bookmarks.description: The main organizational project management interface. All application level changes go through this project using GitHub issues to tie changes to code.
bookmarks.context: This is where to go to create issues and look at the state of the project.

bookmarks.title: PSA-Corporate-Learning-Branch/lsapp: LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application)
bookmarks.description: LSApp (Learning Support Admin Application) acts as middleware between the many different learning systems that CLB deals with. - PSA-Corporate-Learning-Branch/lsapp
bookmarks.context: The primary repository for the code.

steps.name: LearningHUB
steps.objective: The PSA Corporate Learning Branch and its partners offer hundreds of courses, available to all BCPS employees. The LearningHUB is the place to see that full catalogue of corporate offerings.

bookmarks.title: Home | LearningHUB
bookmarks.description: The PSA Corporate Learning Branch and its partners offer hundreds of courses, available to all BCPS employees. The LearningHUB is the place to see that full catalogue of corporate offerings.
bookmarks.context: The site itself. Runs on WordPress, which is on OpenShift but is not under our control. Not sure who actually controls it these days. itservicerequest@gov.bc.ca for support.

bookmarks.title: GitHub Project · LearningHUB
bookmarks.description: GitHub Projects are where the planning and development progress tracking happen.
bookmarks.context: We use a kanban-style system to work in the spirit of agile without much of the dogma.

steps.name: PSA Moodle
steps.objective: Our Moodle installation that we manage ourselves on OpenShift. It integrates with PeopleSoft ELM for enrolment and registration via a custom plugin.

bookmarks.title: bcgov/moodle-nginx at dev
bookmarks.description: Moodle Open-source Learning Management System with OpenShift build using ngnix, mariadb, php-fpm, redis, cron - bcgov/moodle-nginx at dev
bookmarks.context: There's a whole lot goin' on in here. High-availability is complicated.
